verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a cloud-visible agent orchestration platform that handles user code and prompts, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented training-data policy or opt-out control. Running Claude through Amazon Bedrock and bringing your own compute are adjacent deployment options, not a product capability that prevents data from being used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
